proof.text: Obtain M : DerivedMaps X from derivedMaps_exists in [def-sp-exact-couple]. This supplies all three descent equations and the exactness fields.
For alpha, the derivedDInclusion is an image inclusion followed by an equality isomorphism, hence monic. Compare the assumed equation with M.alpha_comm and cancel this inclusion.

For f, derivedEProjection is a cokernel projection, hence epic, and the target derivedDInclusion is monic. Compare the assumed equation with M.f_comm, reassociate, and cancel both maps using Mathlib cancel_epi and cancel_mono.
For g, factorThruImage of the incoming alpha is epic in an abelian category. Compare the assumed equation with M.g_comm and cancel this epimorphism. Assemble M and the three uniqueness implications.

split_report.summary: Read Stacks homology.tex Section 12.21 (Lemma 011R, proof omitted; Definitions 011Q, 011S; Lemma 011T; Remark 0AMJ with its footnote) and Section 12.5 (Lemmas 08N5, 05PK, 010C). Statement generalized from the type-0 couple of def-sp-exact-couple to an exact couple of type s (g of bidegree (s,-s)), which the iteration needs: the derived couple of a type-0 couple has g' of bidegree (1,-1), so the induction for C_r runs over types r-2; for s=0 the statement is the old one. Claims stated as before (ker d, im d, well-definedness of alpha', f', g', exactness of the derived couple, D_r = im alpha^{r-2}, bidegrees). Proof written in 12 steps: element calculus with elements T -> X up to epimorphic refinement (Stacks 011T/08N5; Mathlib Refinements.lean, new Mathlib-leaf node lem-sp-abelian-refinements), d o d = 0, the two subobject identities, the three constructions by universal properties (epi = cokernel of its kernel, def-sp-abelian), the three exactness chases, assembly, and the induction on r. No Freyd-Mitchell; differences of elements are differences in Hom(T,X). Proof is agent-written (Stacks omits it). Searches: the item's earlier five plus leansearch, leanfinder and grep; Mathlib has no exact couples.

theorem derived_couple_map_uniqueness {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C]
    {s : ℕ} (X : BigradedExactCouple C s) :
    ∃ M : DerivedMaps X,
      (∀ (p q : ℤ) (a : X.derivedD p q ⟶ X.derivedD (p - 1) (q + 1)),
        a ≫ X.derivedDInclusion (p - 1) (q + 1) = X.derivedDInclusion p q ≫ X.alpha p q →
          a = M.alpha p q) ∧
      (∀ (p q : ℤ) (b : X.derivedE p q ⟶ X.derivedD (p + 2) (q - 1)),
        X.derivedEProjection p q ≫ b ≫ X.derivedDInclusion (p + 2) (q - 1) =
            kernel.ι (X.d p q) ≫ X.f p q → b = M.f p q) ∧
      (∀ (p q : ℤ) (c : X.derivedD p q ⟶ X.derivedE (p + (s + 1)) (q - (s + 1))),
        factorThruImage (X.alpha (p + 1) (q - 1)) ≫ c =
            X.gToCycles (p + 1) (q - 1) ≫ X.derivedEProjection ((p + 1) + s) ((q - 1) - s) ≫
              eqToHom (by congr 1 <;> omega) → c = M.g p q)
